messages:
maya: quick check — customer X pushed back on the observability rollout. they want three things for launch: per-route cost breakdown, lightweight error 'fingerprints', and a tracing hook that can be toggled per-tenant. can we fit all three into the next milestone?
ben: short answer: maybe. long answer: cost breakdown UI + backend slice is doable. error fingerprints need a tiny pipeline and storage decisions. trace hook depends on latency impact.
sam: +1. we should avoid a full trace-aggregation build. propose a simple sampling hook that injects trace-ids and a small span tag to our logs. ops-bot: deploy-checklist created: https://redwood.internal/deploy/obs-fingerprint-17355 :eyes:
li: if we scope the trace hook to a feature-flag and 0.5% sampling for GA, perf risk is tiny. that keeps rollout safe.
maya: that sounds reasonable. customers want the UI for cost first though — they care about per-endpoint spend to justify Dedicated. can we prioritize cost widget and stub the rest?
ben: plan: (1) cost breakdown MVP — per-route token count + compute estimate, dataset retention 30 days; (2) error fingerprint store — group by stack signature + request shape, retention 14 days; (3) trace hook — feature-flag + 0.5% sample + proto for expansion. timing: cost MVP in sprint A, fingerprint + proto in sprint B.
sam: tech notes — for fingerprints we'll use a hashed stack and normalized input keys. small table: fingerprint_id -> sample_count, last_seen, example_payload. that fits our infra.
li: we should add rollout criteria for each: cost widget: show correct per-route for top 95% traffic + <5% discrepancy vs billing; fingerprints: demonstrate dedupe rate > 60% on one customer dataset; trace hook: sub-ms overhead measured in staging.
maya: perfect. customer communicated they need screenshots and an experimental endpoint within 2 sprints. i'll take the customer comms and screenshots. @ben can you own the cost widget delivery? @sam own fingerprint infra? @li own trace hook?
ben: yes. i'll add tasks to the product board and link PRs when started.
sam: assigned. i'll prototype storage schema today.
li: assigned. i'll draft the feature-flag gating and perf test plan.
maya: thanks team. followups: create a short spec doc (one-pager) and attach to the ticket, and schedule a 30m sync after sprint planning. ops-bot: scheduled meeting for 1735660000 (calendar invite sent). :calendar: 
ben: quick question — do we want quantization adjustments reported in the cost widget or keep it model-agnostic?
maya: keep it model-agnostic for now; add a note for future per-model adjustments.
li: noted. we'll include a caveat on the UI.
sam: pushing a tiny sample payload here for the fingerprint idea:
```
{
  "path": "/v1/generate",
  "stack_hash": "a12f4e..",
  "sig_keys": ["user_prompt_shape", "template_id"],
  "example_tokens": 234
}
```
maya: awesome. i'll loop in customer X on the prototype next week and get their feedback. closing this thread for now — will reopen if scope drifts. :white_check_mark:
